run_visEFTFit_single_subject: run visEFTFit.py to visualize EFT fitting results for a single subject with SMPL mesh rendering
run_visEFTFit_multi_subject: run visEFTFit.py with --multi flag to visualize EFT fitting results for all subjects in an image
run_visEFTFit_turntable: run visEFTFit.py with --turntable flag to render rotating 3D mesh views of fitted SMPL bodies
run_visEFTFit_densepose: run visEFTFit.py with --rendermode densepose to visualize densepose IUV rendering of SMPL mesh
run_visEFTFit_onbbox: run visEFTFit.py with --onbbox flag to show 3D pose visualization in bounding box space
